sensor: 1/2.9" progressive scan RGB CMOS, 1.4 µm pixel
features: Modular AXIS F-Series sensor unit — requires a separate AXIS F91 Main Unit (F9111, F9111-R Mk II, F9114, F9114-R Mk II); power, storage, codecs and streaming are provided by the main unit
4K compact indoor standard sensor, up to 25/30 fps with AXIS F9111
Single SMA connector; cable can be left in place during maintenance or upgrade
Compatible with cables up to 30 m
Can be combined with up to three other sensor units on one main unit
Typical power draw 0.9 W (no max stated)
release_notes: Specs per official Axis datasheet (datasheet-axis-f2108-standard-sensor-en-US-501737.pdf). Sensor unit only: power, storage, codecs, protocols and RTSP come from the paired AXIS F-series main unit, so no configs are recorded.
